+using Newtonsoft.Json;
+
+namespace LlmTornado.Responses.Events;
+
+/// <summary>
+/// Event emitted when a code interpreter call has completed.
+/// </summary>
+public class ResponseEventCodeInterpreterCallCompleted : IResponseAgentEvent
+{
+    [JsonProperty("agent", NullValueHandling = NullValueHandling.Ignore)]
+    public ResponseAgent? Agent { get; set; }
+
+    /// <summary>
+    /// The unique identifier of the code interpreter tool call item.
+    /// </summary>
+    [JsonProperty("item_id")]
+    public string ItemId { get; set; } = string.Empty;
+
+    /// <summary>
+    /// The index of the output item in the response for which the code interpreter call has completed.
+    /// </summary>
+    [JsonProperty("output_index")]
+    public int OutputIndex { get; set; }
+
+    /// <summary>
+    /// The sequence number of this event, used to order streaming events.
+    /// </summary>
+    [JsonProperty("sequence_number")]
+    public int SequenceNumber { get; set; }
+
+    /// <summary>
+    /// The type of the event. Always 'response.code_interpreter_call.completed'.
+    /// </summary>
+    [JsonProperty("type")]
+    public string Type { get; set; } = "response.code_interpreter_call.completed";
+
+    /// <summary>
+    /// The type of this response event.
+    /// </summary>
+    [JsonIgnore]
+    public ResponseEventTypes EventType => ResponseEventTypes.ResponseCodeInterpreterCallCompleted;
+}
